StopReason.description: Why a pass stopped, which is what decides whether to run it again.
StopReason.title: StopReason

changelog.change: Initial shape: the collection, the window, the ceiling, where it stopped.
changelog.why: Deleting one member at a time needs a record of where the next pass starts.

bytes_freed.description: What those deletes freed, or would free. 0 is honest for a collection whose members have no size we can read - a workflow run's logs are one.
bytes_freed.title: Bytes Freed

candidates_seen.description: Members the listing yielded before the pass stopped. Never the size of the collection: a pass that stops on its ceiling stops listing too.
candidates_seen.title: Candidates Seen

collection.description: Which collection this pass walked. A word from a closed vocabulary - `prune.PrunableCollection` for what GitHub holds, a store name for what `state/` holds - and never a path.
collection.title: Collection

deleted.description: How many this pass removed, or would have removed on a dry run. Never above the ceiling when the ceiling is above 0.
deleted.title: Deleted

dry_run.description: True when this pass was only reporting. Nothing was deleted.
dry_run.title: Dry Run

max_deletes_per_run.description: The ceiling in force. 0 is a survey: it reports the first member the window holds and takes nothing.
max_deletes_per_run.title: Max Deletes Per Run

resume_from.description: The member the next pass begins at. Empty when the collection is exhausted, which is the one cell that says the backlog is cleared.
resume_from.title: Resume From

selected.description: Of those, how many the window held. The rest were the wrong age.
selected.title: Selected

since.description: The oldest day a member could be created on and still qualify. Empty when the window has no lower end, which is what an age-based window means: everything older than the line qualifies, however old.
since.title: Since

until.description: The newest day a member could be created on and still qualify, inclusive. Empty when the window has no upper end.
until.title: Until
